messages:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High 5xx rate for tenant 'Orion' in eu-north - routed requests failing at the gateway. Please ack and join #incidents.
Mia (oncall): Acked — jumping in. seeing 50% 5xx on the orion-prod-vpc pool.
Raj (sre): On it. Can you paste the service-level error histogram?
Mia (oncall): quick snapshot from grafana: 5xx spike started ~ 08:12 UTC, ~1200 rps to orion-pool, errors concentrated on model-hosts-02/03.
Hana (infra): Looks like those hosts were part of a warm pool — they report OOM-ish logs. grabbing logs now.
Mia (oncall): Paging Chris (cust-eng) — this is customer-impacting for Orion (Enterprise, EU VPC). Lisa FYI — customer might be seeing timeouts.
Lisa (acct): Confirmed, customer reported degraded latency and failed requests, they're preparing a support call. Prioritize seg isolation.
Chris (cust-eng): I'm on the call queue. Can we drain traffic from eu-north to eu-west as interim? Need to confirm stateful residency implications.
Raj (sre): We can do a controlled shift with our rctl tool. plan: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-west for tenant-orion 2) reduce TTL on customer DNS host to 30s 3) drain incoming at load-balancer for eu-north hosts 4) scale warm pool in eu-west.
Mia (oncall): Agreed. Outline commands and who runs them.
Hana (infra): I'll kick off warm capacity in eu-west now — spinning 6 warm instances in dedicated pool for orion. ETA ~4m.
Alex (dns): I'll lower DNS TTL for orion's endpoint from 300 -> 30. Updating zone now.
Alex (dns): zone update:
```
$ dig txt orion.prod.rdwd.example
; previous TTL 300
```
Applied change via route-control, propagation should be quick.
Mia (oncall): Raj — prepare the traffic-shift command. We want 20% shift -> 50% -> 100% with 2m observation windows.
Raj (sre): running:
```
rctl traffic shift --tenant orion --from eu-north --to eu-west --steps 20,50,100 --wait 120s --health-check "5xx<1%"
```
I'll run the 20% step now.
infra-bot: action: traffic-shift step started by Raj at 2026-03-15T08:21:10Z for tenant orion (20%).
Mia (oncall): Monitoring logs + latency. Chris can you confirm session affinity behavior for redirected requests?
Chris (cust-eng): For orion we have sticky session tokens, but our runtime will accept cross-region requests — KV cache miss rate will increase briefly. We should watch for model-context warming.
Raj (sre): 20% shifted, initial health checks pass for 2m. No spike in 5xx on eu-west. Proceeding to 50%.
infra-bot: action: traffic-shift progressed to 50% at 2026-03-15T08:23:35Z.
Mia (oncall): 50% stable for 5m, error rate in eu-north dropped 60%. eu-west latency +30ms median but 5xx ~0.6%.
Hana (infra): warm instances in eu-west are up and registered. We saw the OOMs on eu-north hosts are due to a model quantizer regression causing memory blowouts.
Raj (sre): Good catch. We'll keep eu-north hosts out of rotation until we have a patched image.
Mia (oncall): Proceed to 100% shift. Raj, execute final step when ready.
Raj (sre): Running final step...
```
rctl traffic shift --tenant orion --from eu-north --to eu-west --to-100 --wait 120s
```
infra-bot: action: traffic-shift completed to 100% at 2026-03-15T08:28:01Z.
Mia (oncall): All production traffic for orion now hitting eu-west. Confirming customer requests are succeeding. Lisa, please relay to customer that we're routing to eu-west as mitigation.
Lisa (acct): On it. Messaging to Orion: "We've shifted traffic to eu-west while we remediate eu-north. There may be a small latency increase; no data lost." Sending now.
Chris (cust-eng): Noted increase in cache-miss rate, model cold-starts showing minor throughput impact. We'll enable aggressive KV prewarming for orion in eu-west: running prewarm job.
Hana (infra): We're starting rolling reprovision of patched hosts in eu-north with updated quantizer build. Will coordinate canary kernel before adding back.
Mia (oncall): ok — containment achieved. Next: 1) finish eu-north patching 2) run soak for 1h in eu-west and monitor QPS/5xx 3) gradual DR-back when ready 4) follow-up postmortem scheduled.
Raj (sre): Incident severity: Sev2 (customer affecting single enterprise tenant, mitigation in place). Logging incident timeline and action items.
Mia (oncall): Handoff: Raj will own remediation, Hana will own infra reprovision, Chris will work with customer for validation, Lisa will stay as customer contact. I'll remain as incident lead for postmortem.
Mia (oncall): Handoff to Raj — time 08:35 UTC. Raj, please ack and take over pager rotations.
Raj (sre): Ack. Taking over. Will update when eu-north hosts patched and can be safety-validated.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: eu-north quantizer-fix build#472 -> rolling canary on host model-hosts-04.
Hana (infra): Canary deployed, running regression tests. No OOMs for 12m so far.
Mia (oncall): Good. Once canary passes 30m soak, we can do a cautious 10% back-shift to eu-north and observe.
Lisa (acct): Customer on call thanks team — they asked for ETA. What should I tell them?
Raj (sre): Tell them we're patching eu-north now; expected canary confirmation in ~30–40 minutes, full remediation and traffic return within 2–3 hours if canary stable.
Chris (cust-eng): I'll ask the customer to run validation test suite after traffic returns. Provide them a test harness link.
Mia (oncall): Adding notes: possible root cause: recent quantizer kernel change that increases peak memory usage under certain prompt lengths. Needs follow-up with eng-ml.
Raj (sre): Action items logged: ENG-ML triage, add memory guardrails to autoscaler, add automated regression that exercises long prompts.
Mia (oncall): Incident timeline saved. Closing immediate incident coordination thread. If any regressions while we shift back, mention here and we'll re-open.
Lisa (acct): Customer satisfied with update. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Raj (sre): Will post postmortem draft in ~24h with root cause and mitigation.
Mia (oncall): Thanks all. Ending handoff.
infra-bot: note: incident thread archived at 2026-03-15T10:05:00Z.
